summary.text: Emma Kerr-Carpenter is a Democratic state senator who represents Montana State Senate District 23, took office in December 2024 after serving in the Montana House from 2018 to 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She serves on the Senate Finance and Claims and Public Health, Welfare and Safety committees.

paragraphs.text: Emma Kerr-Carpenter was born in Watertown, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree in international relations and religion from Boston University in 2012.
Her career experience includes teaching English in Brazil, working as a family support specialist, serving as a youth case manager, and working as a marketing and education coordinator.
Kerr-Carpenter represented Montana House District 49 from 2018 to 2024, where she served on committees including Appropriations, Ethics (as vice chair) and Legislative Audit.
She assumed office in the State Senate on December 3, 2024, and in the 2025-2026 session was assigned to the Finance and Claims and Public Health, Welfare and Safety committees.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Joanna Oblander in the general election.
